Sora 30’s battery capacity and five-hour floor runtime are not transferred to this model.

The WYBOT S2 is a cordless robotic pool cleaner with triple motors, a brushless motor and a dual-layer filtration system. It cleans floors, walls including tiles, steps and waterlines, covers up to 3,229 sq ft and runs for up to 210 minutes per charge. A 3-hour quick charge refills the battery. The WYBOT app offers 6 cleaning paths and 7 cleaning modes, the manual switch offers 3 modes, and a cycle timer can schedule up to 4 runs across 7 days. Self-parking brings the robot to the pool edge for retrieval, and the purchase includes a 30-day return period and a 2-year warranty. The page publishes no robot mass, dimensions, battery capacity, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.

The WYBOT C2 is a cordless robotic pool cleaner that cleans floors, walls and waterlines across 2,152 sq ft with a 180-minute runtime in Eco Mode. Its brushless motor delivers 3,592 GPH, and a dual-layer filtration system pairs a 180 um filter box with a 10 um filter net in a 3 L basket. The WYBOT app provides 7 cleaning modes and 6 paths, a cycle timer, an extra-dirty pool mode and scheduling for up to 4 cleanings per week. An auto-parking system returns the robot to the pool edge for retrieval, and the robot is covered by a 30-day return period and a 2-year warranty. The page publishes no robot mass, dimensions, battery capacity, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or water tank capacity.

Wire-free robotic lawn mower that uses TerraVision 2.0 triple-camera AI vision for mapping, boundary detection and obstacle avoidance, with no RTK or perimeter wire. It covers lawns of up to about 1,000 m² and handles slopes of up to 18 degrees. Made by Shenzhen Muxin Intelligent Technology.

Lightweight AI hip exoskeleton for hiking and walking. A 1.2 hp motor assists hip flexion and extension, it has swappable batteries and IP54 protection, and it comes in Lite, Carbon and Carbon Pro editions. It was introduced via Kickstarter in 2024.

AI knee exoskeleton, billed by DNSYS as the world's first, and designed to be mix-and-match compatible with the X1 hip exoskeleton. Crowdfunded with more than 2,000 backers, with rolling shipments in 2025.

Consumer ankle exoskeleton paired with dedicated sneakers that acts as an 'extra calf muscle'. It learns the wearer's gait and adds push-off assistance at adjustable power levels. Sold as a wellness product, not a medical device.
Powered hiking pants made with Arc'teryx, with motorized knee modules built into Gamma pants. Skip claims 40% more power on climbs and knee support on descents. Skip is a Google X spin-out.

Third-generation driverless road delivery vehicle built with BYD North America. It has 27 cu ft of temperature-controlled storage, an external pedestrian airbag, a 360-degree camera/lidar/radar/thermal sensor suite and a 52 kWh battery.
Autonomous last-mile delivery robot with an automatic package dispenser for unattended drop-off onto doorsteps or into lockers. Debuted at CES 2023 and offered as Robotics-as-a-Service.

Small, remotely driven sidewalk food-delivery robot from Toronto, piloted with foodora in 2020. Five cameras give the remote driver a 220-degree view. It weighs 10 lb, carries up to 6 lb in a locked trunk, travels at up to 6 km/h and has a 12-hour battery life.

Flagship all-wheel-drive robot mower series (3000F, 6000F and 12000F) for lawns of 3,000 to 12,000 m2. It navigates without a boundary wire using Tri-Fusion positioning: 360-degree LiDAR, NetRTK and four cameras that recognise more than 300 object types. It climbs slopes of up to 80% (38.6 degrees) and takes an optional edge-trimming accessory. Announced at IFA 2026, with pre-orders in Q4 2026.

Compact all-wheel-drive robot mower. The 1000 model (1,000 m2) uses tri-camera AI vision with NetRTK, and the 1500 model uses 360-degree LiDAR with dual cameras. It needs no boundary wire, has an edge-cutting disc and detects obstacles as small as 2.5 x 2.5 cm. Rated IPX6.

Mammotion's first robotic pool cleaner. The cordless unit cleans the floor, walls and waterline of pools up to 150 m2. It has a 6000 mAh battery, three brushless motors giving up to 5,800 GPH of suction, a 180-micron filter, five cleaning modes and automatic parking at the waterline.

All-wheel-drive version of Segway Navimow's wire-free i2 mower for everyday lawns. The i206 AWD covers 0.15 acre and the i210 AWD 0.25 acre. It uses Xero-turn AWD steering that is gentle on turf and climbs 45% (24 degree) slopes. Unveiled at CES 2026, with pre-orders from January 16, 2026.
Segway Navimow's commercial all-wheel-drive robotic mower series for large sites, with 'drop and mow' setup. The CM120M1 covers up to 3 acres and the CM240M1 up to 6 acres. Unveiled at CES 2026.

Cordless robotic pool cleaner with a triple-brush cleaning system, ultrasonic distance sensing and a high-precision IMU. It recharges wirelessly and automatically and is controlled from an app. Pre-orders opened in 2023 with delivery expected in January 2024.

Sunseeker's first LiDAR robot mower, for lawns up to 1,000 m2. Its 172-channel LiDAR is combined with AI vision, so it needs no perimeter wire or antenna. It handles slopes of 42% (22 degrees), avoids obstacles in 3D and is rated IPX6. CES Innovation Awards 2026 honoree; launched March 3, 2026.

Flagship 2027-model-year all-wheel-drive robot mower for up to 3,000 m2. It maps with 360-degree LiDAR and AI vision and needs no base station. It climbs 80% slopes, cuts with a 35 cm dual-disc deck and supports an optional EdgeZero trimmer head. Shown at IFA 2026.

2027-model-year all-wheel-drive LiDAR robot mower for mid-sized to large gardens up to 1,800 m2. It climbs 80% slopes, uses the AllSense 2.0 perception system and has a dedicated cut-to-edge disc. Shown at IFA 2026.

ECOVACS' first cordless robotic pool cleaner, covering up to 180 m2. It has 4,800 GPH suction, four roller brushes and two filter layers (180 and 3 microns). It navigates with SmartNavi IMU, has an IP68 body and a 4600 mAh battery, and climbs obstacles of 5.5 cm.

Four-wheel-drive wire-free robot mower for yards up to 5,000 m2. OmniSense 3.0 combines 360-degree 3D LiDAR with dual 1080p HDR cameras and recognises more than 300 obstacle types. It climbs 80% (38.7 degree) slopes and cuts a 40 cm swath. EdgeMaster 2.0 edge trimming leaves gaps under 3 cm, and Garden Guardian adds video security.
Solar-powered robotic pool cleaner from WYBOT, reviewed by Forbes in August 2023.
All-wheel-drive robotic mower for slopes of up to 70% and areas of up to 3,500 m². It has ultrasonic object detection, LED headlights and Alexa/Google Home integration. It is now discontinued.

NERA-generation all-wheel-drive Automower that handles 70% slopes inside the work area. It covers up to 5,000 m² with systematic mowing (3,500 m² random) and has ultrasonic object detection and zone control.
Wire-free entry NERA mower with virtual boundaries and EdgeCut for gardens up to 900 m². It is controlled with the Automower Connect app and has electric cutting-height adjustment from 20 to 55 mm.
NERA mower with front radar object detection, EdgeCut and Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and cellular connectivity. Its working capacity is 600 m² (±20%) and it handles 30% slopes inside the area.
Mid-size NERA mower with EdgeCut and virtual boundaries for lawns up to 1,500 m² with systematic patterns. It has electric cutting-height adjustment and GeoFence theft protection.
NERA mower with radar object detection and EdgeCut for lawns of about 1,000 m². It has GPS theft tracking, smart-home integration and electric cutting height from 20 to 55 mm.
Wire-free NERA mower with AI Vision camera object detection, satellite navigation and EdgeCut, for lawns up to 900 m². It was announced in October 2025 as part of Husqvarna's 2026 AI Vision range.
AI Vision NERA mower for lawns up to 1,500 m², with camera object avoidance, EdgeCut, selectable mowing patterns and electric height adjustment.
Large-garden AI Vision NERA mower with virtual boundaries for up to 4,800 m². It handles 50% slopes and has a 24 cm cutting width.
Flagship AI Vision NERA mower that covers up to 7,500 m² with systematic patterns. It handles slopes of up to 50% inside the work area.
Entry-level wire-free mower with AI vision and satellite navigation for gardens up to 600 m². It is rated IPX6 and runs at 63 dB(A).
Wire-free AI vision mower for gardens up to 800 m², with selectable mowing patterns and smart-home integration. It launched on 2 March 2026.
Wire-free AI vision mower for gardens up to 1,200 m², with camera object avoidance and satellite navigation. It needs Wi-Fi coverage across the whole lawn.
Wire-free robotic mower with camera-based AI navigation, edge detection and obstacle avoidance. It comes in 400 m² and 600 m² versions, handles 25% slopes and cuts at 25 to 45 mm.
Faster EVO version of the iMOW 5 for lawns up to 1,500 m². It handles slopes of up to 45% (60% with an extension kit) and uses a 28 cm Disc Cut system.
Mid-range iMOW robotic mower for lawns up to 3,000 m², with a 28 cm Disc Cut system, app or voice control and a rain sensor.
Large-lawn iMOW robotic mower for areas up to 5,000 m², with a 28 cm Disc Cut system and app or voice control.

Lightweight AI walking and sports exoskeleton from Haier, unveiled at AWE 2026 in March 2026 and put on sale on 26 May 2026 for 15,999 CNY. It has a T700 carbon-fibre and titanium frame weighing 1.75 kg, non-Newtonian-fluid joint padding, dual high-torque motors giving up to 16 N·m of assistance per leg (about 5 kg of load relief), and a gait algorithm that adapts to 12 everyday activities and terrains, cutting energy use by up to 37%.

The UBHOME M10 is a wire-free robotic lawn mower from UBTECH's UBHOME line, first shown at CES 2025, that combines RTK positioning (base station, antenna and gateway) with self-developed environment perception, SLAM and AI obstacle avoidance on a Qualcomm RB1 platform, plus a LoRa link. It was crowdfunded and then sold for 1,499 USD, with a maximum cutting height of 6 cm.

The EGO AURA-R2 is a wire-free robotic mower range from EGO (Chervon) in three models, RMR1500E, RMR3000E and RMR6000E, for lawns of 1,500, 3,000 and 6,000 m2. It manages up to 40 zones via the EGO Connect app, stops or diverts for children, pets and objects using cameras, sensors and GPS, has headlights for night mowing, mulches clippings, handles 50% slopes and includes PIN, GPS tracking, geofencing and remote locking; available from March 2026.

The Lymow One Plus is the second-generation tracked, wire-free robotic mower from Lymow, navigating with RTK, VSLAM and stereo cameras (LySee vision) and recognising 20+ yard objects including pets and hedgehogs. It adds 50% more cutting power with SK5 steel mulching blades, a cyclone-airflow system that lifts grass and clears clippings, heated camera housings and a self-cleaning track system, in 5 Ah and 10 Ah battery versions; unveiled at CES 2026 and shipping from March 2026.

The TerraMow X AWD is a 42 V all-wheel-drive robotic mower with full suspension and Ackermann steering whose Shuttle Drive mows back and forth instead of pivoting at row ends, climbing 90% (42-degree) slopes and 7 cm obstacles. It navigates without wires or antenna using the six-camera TerraVision 2.0 system with nRTK, cuts with three motors (900 W) over a 50.2 cm deck at 25-100 mm height and covers up to 1.5 acres (2.7 with extra batteries); crowdfunded on Kickstarter in 2026 with a planned 3,599 USD retail price.

The Sunseeker Elite X8 Plus (with the standard X8) is a flagship wire-free robotic mower that navigates with AONavi 3.0 (network RTK, solid-state LiDAR and Vision AI) plus a day-and-night infrared camera for animal detection. Its ATC Pro AWD with rear-wheel steering and four-wheel suspension climbs 39-degree slopes, it has a 15.4-inch cutting width with 0.8-4 inch height, 1.3 mph cutting speed, a 15 Ah battery, IPX6 rating and EdgeZero 2.0 edge trimming; shown at Equip Expo 2026.

The Kress Voyager KR804 is a 60-inch commercial autonomous mower from Positec's Kress brand that mows up to 2.5 acres per hour and up to 19 acres per charge from a 38 kWh battery. It navigates without boundary wires using RTK, LiDAR, VisionAI and a 360-degree multi-sensor obstacle-detection suite for centimetre-level accuracy; it debuted at Equip Expo in October 2026 with dealer availability the same month.

The Kress KR238 Master11 is an autonomous mower for golf-course fairways with a 24.4-inch three-disc cutting system adjustable from 0.4 to 3.9 inches, covering up to 5 acres in 12 hours or 20 acres in 48 hours. It combines tri-camera vision, RTK, time-of-flight and ultrasonic sensors with VisionAI and VSLAM for 360-degree obstacle avoidance, handles 40% (22-degree) slopes, mows at 2.2, 3.4 or 4.5 mph and adds AI turf-disease detection; availability was set for late summer 2026.

The ECOVACS GOAT O600 RTK is an entry-level wire-free robotic mower for gardens up to 600 m2 that navigates by RTK with a reference antenna and uses cameras for AI obstacle detection, with headlights and a small-animal protection mode that stops night mowing by default. Introduced at CES 2026, it launched in Europe at about 649-650 EUR as a smaller sibling of the GOAT O800 RTK.

The MAMMOTION YUKA mini Vision is a vision-only wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 700 m2 that navigates with a triple-camera system and Smart Edging, detecting obstacles as small as 5 x 5 cm and working in low light without RTK antennas. It climbs 45% slopes, cuts a 190 mm swath with five pivoting blades, uses a removable 4.5 Ah battery and supports one-click mapping, Alexa and Google Home; it was released in Europe in July 2025.

The Roborock RockMow X1 LiDAR (sold as X120H and X130H) is an all-wheel-drive robotic mower that maps and navigates by 360-degree LiDAR (about 200,000 points per second, up to 230 ft range) plus an AI vision camera, with no wires, RTK or satellite positioning. It climbs 38.7-degree slopes and 3.1-inch obstacles with dynamic suspension, mows up to 2,000 m2 per day with 1.6-3.5 inch cutting height and 3 cm edge cutting, is IPX6 rated and includes 4G anti-theft; shown at CES 2026 and launched in the US in July 2026 at 3,200 USD (X120H).

The eufy Robot Lawn Mower C15 is Anker's entry-level wire-free robotic mower for yards up to 500 m2, using the camera-based Vision FSD navigation of the E-Series for mapping and obstacle avoidance without boundary wire or RTK. It handles 32% slopes and offers app scheduling and map management; unveiled at MWC 2026 for a European launch between March and June 2026 at 899 EUR.

The Dreame Apex Embodied AI Mower is a prototype robotic lawn mower with a gripper arm, unveiled at AWE 2026 in Shanghai, that can move obstacles such as toys out of its path to already-mowed areas and is also intended to water gardens. Specifications, pricing and release timing had not been announced.

The PUDU TOMO S Series is Pudu Robotics' first consumer product, a wire-free robotic lawn mower family announced on November 3, 2026 with sales expected in spring 2027. Its SharpLoop system sharpens the rotary blades at the charging station, dual 636 W motors spin the blades at up to 6,000 rpm, four hub motors handle slopes up to 45 degrees, and 360-degree lidar, AI vision and network RTK give centimeter-level positioning; three versions cover lawns from 1,500 to 5,000 m².

The Z5 is an L4 driverless urban delivery van (RoboVan) from Suzhou-based Zelos (Jiushi Intelligent), launched in 2023 as what the company calls the first mass-produced L4 urban delivery vehicle. It carries up to 1,000 kg in a 6 m³ cargo box with a range of 180 km (standard) or 260 km (long-range battery); Zelos also sells Z5 Lite, Z5 Pro and refrigerated variants.

The Neolix X1 is a compact 'final-feet' delivery robot from Beijing-based RoboVan maker Neolix, shown as a prototype at its CES 2026 debut in January 2026. Designed for the last 100 meters, it moves between sidewalks, building lobbies and doorways, handles elevator delivery, and complements Neolix's X3, X6 and H12 autonomous delivery vans for door-to-door delivery.

CEORA is Husqvarna's large-area professional robotic mower for sports fields and golf turf, using EPOS satellite navigation with virtual boundaries and a modular drive unit with attachable cutting decks such as the RZ 43M. Husqvarna rates it for up to about 18 acres (75,000 m²) of regular-quality turf, with three cutting discs and electric cutting-height adjustment from 0.8 to 2.8 in.

The Automower 520 EPOS is a wire-free professional robotic mower from Husqvarna for commercial fleet use, navigating with RTK-GNSS virtual boundaries (an EPOS RS5 reference station is required). It covers up to 5,000 m², handles slopes up to 45% and cuts a 24 cm swath at 20-60 mm; it was launched in 2024 as a sibling of the Automower 550 EPOS.

The Automower 535 AWD EPOS is Husqvarna's all-wheel-drive professional robotic mower combining satellite-based EPOS virtual boundaries with the ability to climb slopes up to 70% (35°). It covers up to 6,000 m² with a 22 cm cutting width and is managed through Husqvarna Fleet Services; it was introduced in late 2024 and shown in the US at the 2025 GCSAA show.

The Automower 560 EPOS is a wire-free commercial robotic mower from Husqvarna built on a new medium-sized platform that is ready for an AI-assisted vision accessory. It covers up to 12,000 m², handles slopes up to 50% with a pivoting front axle and cuts a 26 cm swath at 20-60 mm using EPOS RTK-GNSS navigation.

The Automower 580L EPOS is a low-cut wire-free robotic mower from Husqvarna for golf courses and sports turf, sold through golf and sports-turf dealers and launched at the 2025 GCSAA Conference. It uses EPOS virtual boundaries and radar object detection, cuts at 0.4-2 in with a 10.2 in width and is rated for up to 4 acres at standard mowing frequency.

Amazon Scout was a fully electric, six-wheeled autonomous sidewalk delivery robot that travelled at walking pace and debuted on January 23, 2019, delivering packages in Snohomish County, Washington. Field tests later expanded to Irvine, Atlanta and Franklin, Tennessee, before Amazon scaled back the program in 2022.

AI hip-assist walking exoskeleton from Yuanshan Zhixing, the consumer brand of China Ordnance's Hangzhou Zhiyuan Research Institute; the new generation (AsExo-TK2000) launched in April 2026 after the first Tashan in May 2025. It weighs 2.4 kg in carbon composite, recognises gait and terrain with over 99% accuracy, folds into a backpack, runs 4-6 hours and supports walking or running up to 18 km/h, with uses in elderly mobility and scenic-area rental.

Lightweight walking-assist exoskeleton from CETC's 21st Research Institute and CETC Robotics, presented in 2025 for outdoor walking and everyday mobility of older people. It weighs 2.2 kg, uses aerospace-grade carbon-fibre composite and bionic joints, and a multimodal sensor array with AI algorithms reads posture, joint angles and gait to assist the wearer; it went on sale on JD.com for under 6,000 CNY after discounts in late 2025, and the 'Baihong Tansuo' version shown at WRC 2026 is rated at 35% assist efficiency.

Maston is MAMMOTION's commercial autonomous mowing series for golf courses, sports fields, parks and estates, offered with rotary (brush clearing) or flail (fine turf) cutting heads and managed through MAMMOTION Fleet Management. It navigates with the Tri-Fusion 2.0 system (360-degree LiDAR, three AI cameras, NetRTK and four ultrasonic sensors), uses AWD with zero-turn front steering, handles slopes up to 70% and charges on a 500 W fast-charging station. Shown at IFA 2026 and available for pre-order through European and Australian distributors.

LUBA mini AWD LiDAR is MAMMOTION's compact all-wheel-drive robotic mower and the first to use its Tri-Fusion positioning (solid-state 144-beam LiDAR producing up to 200,000 points per second, NetRTK and AI vision) without an RTK antenna. It covers gardens up to 1,500 m2, climbs 80% (38.6-degree) slopes and manages 20 mowing zones; it went on sale in 2025.

The Sunseeker S3 is a wire-free robotic lawn mower for gardens up to 800 m2 that combines full-band RTK (with a base station) and VSLAM in a DualFusion navigation system, plus Vision AI recognising more than 360 obstacle types on a 5 TOPS chip. It has an 18 cm cutting width, 20-60 mm cutting height, 30% (17-degree) climbing ability and IPX5 protection; it was unveiled at spoga+gafa 2025 for a 2026 launch.

The Sunseeker V1 is an entry-level vision-only robotic mower for simple lawns of about 300 m2 that uses Vision AI to detect lawn boundaries and more than 360 obstacle types without perimeter wires, mapping or installation. It weighs 6.7 kg, runs at 55 dB, has a 16 cm cutting width, 20-50 mm cutting height and front-wheel drive for slopes up to 27% (15 degrees); it was unveiled at spoga+gafa 2025 for a 2026 launch.

The Sunseeker Elite X4 is a drop-and-go robotic mower that navigates by L-SLAM with a 360-degree 3D LiDAR (210,000 points per second, 360 x 70-degree field of view) fused with a monocular camera on a 10 TOPS chip, needing no boundary wire or RTK antenna. It auto-maps the lawn in 3D, has a 20 cm cutting width with 20-60 mm cutting height and rear-wheel drive for slopes up to 45%; it is part of the Sunseeker Elite X Range launched in 2026.

The Sunseeker Elite X9 Series (X9 and X9 Plus) are professional robotic mowers for estates, parks and sports grounds, covering 12,000 m2 (X9) or 24,000 m2 (X9 Plus) within 48 hours with fleet management. They fuse RTK and VSLAM 2.0 on a 10 TOPS chip, use a 16-sensor OmniSight system with eight cameras and infrared night vision, four-wheel drive for 90% (42-degree) slopes, dual 43 cm cutting discs and EdgeZero edge cutting; shown at CES 2026 with US availability from Q2 2026.

The Sunseeker Elite X3 Gen 2 is a compact wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 800 m2 that uses the AONavi 2.0 system (network RTK plus VSLAM with a standard 4G-GPS module) so no local RTK base station is needed. It adds Vision AI obstacle avoidance on a 10 TOPS chip, independent suspension, rear active steering and 30% climbing ability; it is part of the 2026 X Gen 2 Series.

The Sunseeker Elite X5 Gen 2 is a wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 2,000 m2 using AONavi 2.0 (network RTK plus VSLAM 2.0 with binocular and iToF cameras) for day-and-night navigation on a 10 TOPS chip. It has tri-wheel AWD for 60% (30-degree) slopes, an 8.7-inch cutting disc and an edge-trimming micro-blade deck; it debuted in 2026 as part of the X Gen 2 Series.

The Sunseeker Elite X7 Gen 2 (and higher-capacity X7 Plus Gen 2) is a wire-free AWD robotic mower for large lawns of up to 6,000 m2, navigating with network RTK plus VSLAM 2.0 and Vision AI 2.0 (binocular plus iToF cameras) on a 10 TOPS chip. It uses a 14-inch dual cutting disc, continuous 0.8-4.0 inch height adjustment and climbs 70% (35-degree) slopes; it launched in 2026 as part of the X Gen 2 Series.

The ANTHBOT M5 is a compact wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 500 m2 that navigates with full-band RTK, dual AI vision and 4G, sets up in about 10 minutes and passes through gaps as narrow as 65 cm. It offers app-based multi-zone scheduling, AI obstacle recognition and rain-sensing auto return; it went on sale in 2026.

The ANTHBOT M9 is a compact wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 1,000 m2 using full-band RTK plus dual-vision navigation with 4G, automatic mapping and route planning, and AI obstacle recognition. It passes 65 cm passages, supports multi-zone scheduling in the ANTHBOT app and returns to its dock when rain is detected; it launched in 2026.

The ANTHBOT M5 LiDAR is a compact robotic mower for enclosed gardens up to 500 m2 that navigates with 360-degree LiDAR plus dual vision, so it needs neither boundary wires nor an RTK station and can start mowing about three minutes after unboxing. It recognises more than 1,000 obstacle types and supports one-touch mapping, edge cutting and scheduling; it was sold from 2026.

The ANTHBOT M9 Pro (with the smaller 500 m2 M5 Pro sibling) is a wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 1,000 m2 using HoloSense quad-fusion navigation (360-degree LiDAR, RTK, NetRTK and dual AI vision) with no RTK installation. It manages up to 32 zones, recognises over 1,000 obstacle types, passes 65 cm gaps, climbs 45% (24-degree) slopes, runs at 58 dB or less and is IPX6 rated; it was unveiled at spoga+gafa 2026 and launched in July 2026.

The ANTHBOT N8 is a 4-in-1 robotic lawn mower for lawns up to 1,500 m2 that mows, collects clippings into a 23-litre bag, mulches and sweeps leaves, and drives itself to a designated dumping point when the bag is full. It navigates with full-band RTK and dual vision plus 4G; it is on sale from 1,599 EUR in Europe and 1,699 USD in the US and was named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026.

The ANTHBOT R7 Series is an AWD robotic mower with an EdgeEase robotic trimming arm that uses dedicated LiDAR and camera sensors to cut flush along walls, fences and flower beds. It has a six-motor drive (four drive, two steering) for 84% (40-degree) slopes and 6 cm obstacles, a 270 Wh 36 V battery for up to 4,000 m2 per day with 60-minute fast charging, HoloSense navigation (dual LiDAR, PPP-RTK and AI vision) and infrared animal detection; unveiled at IFA 2026 with pricing to follow.

The ANTHBOT Pion is a perimeter-wire robotic lawn mower for lawns of about 600 m2 (perimeter up to 180 m) that builds a real-time map for systematic path planning instead of random mowing. It adjusts cutting height automatically, handles slopes up to 45% (24 degrees), detects boundary-wire breaks and resumes mowing after interruptions; it has been sold since 2023.

The Yarbo M Series (M20/M20i) is a compact modular yard robot for standard residential yards whose tracked core accepts mower, snow blower and leaf collector modules, with trimmer and smart-assist modules planned. It navigates with Yarbo Data Center Gen2, NetRTK and optional LiDAR without boundary wires, climbs about 35-degree (70%) slopes, tows about 100 kg, wirelessly recharges from 10 to 90% in about 65 minutes and can mow up to 1.5 acres per day; prototyped at CES 2026, crowdfunded with over 3.6 million USD and shown in final form at IFA 2026.

The Yarbo Y40P is the upgraded core of Yarbo's Y Series modular yard robot for large properties, pairing with Lawn Mower Pro, Snow Blower Gen 2, Blower and Trimmer modules. It uses brushless hub-motor drive for slopes up to 70% (35 degrees) and travels at up to 1.2 m/s; it went on sale in 2026 at 5,599 USD for the core alone.

The VIGX π6 series by Shenzhen Kenqing Technology is a pocket-size hip exoskeleton whose main unit folds to about 27 x 9 x 9 cm and weighs about 1.2 kg, with a quick-release split design, telescopic leg bars and a belt dock that doubles as a phone power bank. It adds radar and visual terrain recognition to pre-adjust assistance and supports about 20 km of walking per charge with swappable batteries; first shown at CES 2026 and launched in Shenzhen on 23 October 2026, with Kickstarter reservations open.

The VIGX π is a 1.8 kg carbon-fibre and magnesium-alloy hip exoskeleton from Shenzhen Kenqing Technology for hiking and climbing that uses a self-learning gait algorithm to adjust assistance. It has one-touch power-off and mechanical limiters; Kenqing deployed 500 units of the π series for rental on Mount Tai from February 2025.

The VIGX π Plus is a 2.1 kg carbon-fibre hip exoskeleton for hiking, climbing and load carrying that samples gait data at 1000 Hz to adjust torque, recovers energy on descents and supports assisted speeds up to 15 km/h. Its hot-swappable dual batteries give more than 24,000 assisted steps, and the maker cites a 35-40% knee-load reduction on 15-degree inclines; it is sold through VIGX's online store.

The VIGX Ant-H1 Pro is a walking-assist hip exoskeleton of about 5 lb (carbon fibre and aluminium) that applies synchronized hip torque through bilateral actuators to make walking and climbing easier for seniors and active users. It offers an assist mode and a resistance (damping) training mode, a magnetic swappable battery good for up to 12,000 steps, and app control with remote location tracking.

The IRMO M1 Ultra from Hangzhou Hangmo Technology (a Beihang University spin-off) is a knee exoskeleton for hiking, running and cycling that uses a 120-degree camera and LiDAR plus a nine-axis IMU to read the terrain ahead and adapt assistance. Its 1,000 W drive delivers up to 18 Nm of torque and up to 45% knee assistance with up to 60% impact reduction, the carbon-fibre unit weighs about 2.2 kg and runs 6-8 hours; it was crowdfunded on Kickstarter (over 1.1 million USD) and began shipping abroad in 2026, alongside lower-spec M1 Pure and M1 Pro versions.

VIATRIX X is the seventh-generation range-extended powered hip exoskeleton for hiking and mountaineering from Shanghai-based ULS Robotics (Aoshark), released in September 2026. It uses an AI motion system with 0.5-1 ms response to recognise gait and predict intent, an in-house automotive-grade motor with a Boost mode delivering 50 Nm, a Float360 floating hip structure with 8 degrees of freedom and IP65 water and dust protection.

VIATRIX is the first consumer exoskeleton from Shanghai industrial-exoskeleton maker ULS Robotics (Aoshark), a range-extended powered hip exoskeleton for hiking unveiled at WAIC in July 2025. It combines AI motion control, in-house automotive-grade motors and a Float360 floating hip architecture with four degrees of freedom, uses quick-swap batteries and won a CES 2026 Innovation Award.

The PowrGo H1 is a consumer hip exoskeleton for everyday walking from Yuanye Technology (Suzhou), launched at the 2026 West Bund International Tech Consumer Carnival in Shanghai. Dual motors deliver up to 20 Nm per side (1,000 W peak), it weighs at most 2.3 kg, has a 43.2 Wh battery for about 18 km, IP54 protection, a stable-walking mode for older users and sit-to-stand assistance.

The PowrGo H1 Ultra is the outdoor-performance version of Yuanye Technology's consumer hip exoskeleton for hiking, mountaineering and long walks, launched in Shanghai in October 2026. It provides up to 30 Nm per side (1,500 W peak), uses magnesium and titanium alloys for a weight of at most 2.5 kg, carries an 87.6 Wh battery for about 36 km, is IP54 rated and supports users up to 135 kg.

The GoGo-H Pro is a consumer walking-assist hip exoskeleton from Hangzhou rehabilitation-exoskeleton maker RoboCT (Chengtian Technology), launched at the World Robot Conference in August 2026 as a family exoskeleton for older people and active users. Its AI gait-adaptive algorithm, trained on clinical rehabilitation data, recognises walking, stairs and hill climbing as well as abnormal gaits; it has an aluminium and carbon-fibre frame of 2.2 kg, a 1,000 W assist motor, about 18 km range per battery and IP54 protection.

The NexLawn VIDAR series from MOVA Group's outdoor brand NexLawn is a wire-free robotic mower for lawns up to 2,000 m2 that maps automatically with NexDetect (3D LiDAR, stereo vision and AI) and needs no RTK base station. It recognises more than 300 object types, passes 60 cm paths, handles 4 cm bumps and 50% slopes, trims edges with NexTrim to under 1 cm and offers 3-10 cm cutting height; it debuted at IFA 2025.

The NexLawn VIDAR AWD series is an all-wheel-drive version of the VIDAR LiDAR-and-stereo-vision robotic mower for lawns up to 3,000 m2, with hub motors, off-road wheels and suspension for 80% slopes and 6 cm obstacles. It uses 40 cm dual cutting discs on a 36 V battery, NexTrim edge cutting to about 1.5 cm and an optional grass collector; it debuted at IFA 2025.

The NexLawn NAVIA 6000 AWD is a robotic mower for complex lawns up to 1.5 acres that combines 360-degree LiDAR, AI stereo vision and satellite-delivered RTK corrections (NexNav), so it needs no base station, Wi-Fi or cellular subscription. Four hub motors with air suspension handle 80% slopes and 2.4-inch obstacles, a 15.8-inch dual six-blade floating deck on a 36 V system mows up to 0.9 acres per day with 1.2-3.9 inch electronic height adjustment; unveiled at CES 2026 for a spring 2026 launch.

The NexLawn Master X is a robotic lawn mower with a multi-gripper robotic arm on a 25 cm-high AWD chassis that can clear stones, toys and branches, hold a hose to water plants, pick low fruit and throw a ball for pets; the arm folds to 44.5 cm and extends to 77 cm for about 1 m of reach. Its arm modules can be swapped for trimmer or edging heads; it was unveiled as a concept at IFA 2025 and shown again at CES 2026.

The NexLawn AURION F115 is a commercial robotic mower for golf courses, sports fields and large campuses that maintains up to 60,000 m2 (15 acres) with a 60 cm three-disc cutting system on a 48 V platform and grass-height adjustment in 1 mm steps. It senses with NexFusion Pro (3D LiDAR, stereo cameras, NRTK, infrared and ToF), maps turf health using NDVI and is managed in fleets of 30+ units via NexFleet; it was launched at IFA 2026.

The NexLawn VAYOR 600 is an entry-level home robotic lawn mower for small gardens from NexLawn, an outdoor brand of the Dreame-affiliated group, launched at IFA 2026 alongside updated NAVIA PRO AWD and VIDAR 1200/2000 AWD models. Detailed specifications had not been published at launch.

The Dreame Zircon 2 Ultra is Dreame Pool's flagship cordless robotic pool cleaner for pools up to 4,300 sq ft, using PulseMap (LDS laser radar with multi-sensor fusion) to build a 3D model of the pool for adaptive navigation and obstacle avoidance. A four-pump QuadLift system provides 10,000 GPH suction for floors, walls, steps, waterlines and shallow zones, it surfaces and docks at a user-selected spot and runs up to 6 hours; shown at CES 2026 ahead of a 2026 release.

The Dreame Z1 is a cordless robotic pool cleaner for pools up to 1,950 sq ft with floor, wall and waterline modes, 8,000 GPH suction from dual pump motors, dual brushes, a 180-micron filter and PoolSense tangle-free navigation. It is the simpler sibling of the Z1 Pro, lacking its LiFi underwater remote and auto poolside parking; it was sold from 2025.

The Dreame J1 is a solar-powered robotic pool skimmer that cleans the water surface continuously using SolarSmart charging, 360-degree surface cleaning and a redesigned flow path, with app-based cleaning-mode settings and real-time monitoring. It was listed on Dreame's global store in September 2025.

The Dreame A3 AWD is a wire-free, RTK-free robotic mower that navigates with OmniSense 3.0 3D vision, sold in 1000 (0.25 acre) and 2000 (0.5 acre) versions. Its four-wheel drive climbs 80% (38.7-degree) slopes and 2.2-inch obstacles, it recognises more than 300 obstacle types and includes 4G-based anti-theft tracking; it went on sale in 2026 as the non-Pro sibling of the A3 AWD Pro.

The Segway Navimow H5 Pro is a wire-free robotic mower with the EdgeMaestro extendable robotic arm, which pushes the main cutting disc out by 7.7 cm with omnidirectional floating for zero-gap edge mowing, aided by a rake module and dual guide wheels. It navigates with the EFLS tri-fusion system (LiDAR, vision and network RTK), uses Xero-Turn AWD with four hub motors and rear suspension for 80% (38.6-degree) slopes and 6 cm obstacles, and combines triple AI cameras, LiDAR and thermal infrared to detect animals at night; unveiled at IFA 2026.

The Segway Navimow i2 LiDAR Pro (i210 and i220 LiDAR Pro) is a wire-free, antenna-free robotic mower for 1,000-2,000 m2 lawns that fuses solid-state LiDAR (about 200,000 scans per second), network RTK and vision in the EFLS tri-fusion system and adds Xero-Turn AWD. It climbs 55% slopes on off-road wheels, passes 70 cm gaps, uses VisionFence obstacle avoidance, runs at 59 dB(A) and is IP66 rated; it was introduced in Europe in 2026.

The original Segway Navimow H Series (H500E, H800E, H1500E and H3000E, for lawns of 500 to 3,000 m2) are boundary-wire-free robotic mowers that navigate by RTK-GNSS with a reference station, with an optional VisionFence camera module for AI obstacle avoidance and 4G anti-theft tracking. In the US they are sold as H800-VF, H1500-VF and H3000-VF; the line was on sale and reviewed in Europe in 2023.

The Aiper Scuba V3 Ultra is a 6-in-1 cordless robotic pool cleaner that uses cognitive AI and dual cameras (2 m detection range, more than 20 debris and obstacle types) to choose cleaning modes and run a 7-day hands-free schedule, cleaning floors, walls, waterline, surface and sun shelves as shallow as 20 cm plus a chlorine chamber. It has dual pumps with up to 32,200 L/h suction, 180- and 3-micron filtration, JellyFloat buoyancy control, up to 240 minutes of floor cleaning and weighs 13 kg; it went on sale in 2026 for 2,299.99 USD.

The Beatbot AquaSense is a cordless robotic pool cleaner for floors, walls and waterline with path optimisation on a quad-core 1.8 GHz processor, 2x2 independent roller brushes and a brushless main pump with up to 5,500 GPH suction. A 6,700 mAh battery gives 3.5 hours of floor cleaning, it returns to its starting point and parks at the waterline, is IP68 rated and charges on a cordless dock; it has been sold since 2023.

The WYBOT B1 is a compact, lightweight cordless robotic pool cleaner for pools up to 1,150 sq ft that cleans floors, walls, waterline, steps and slopes for up to 120 minutes. It uses three motors, quad roller brushes, side brushes for edge cleaning and a 180-micron filter, with app-selected cleaning modes and OTA updates; it went on sale in 2026.

The MOVA Rover X10 is a flagship cordless robotic pool cleaner whose FloatDrive system of four jet-drive motors lets it hover and lift underwater like a drone, cleaning surface, floor, walls, waterline, corners, steps and shallow areas. It maps pools up to 500 m2 with an underwater LDS laser sensor, uses 15 motors, 10,000 GPH suction, a 5 L basket filtering down to 3 microns and a 15,000 mAh battery for up to 6 hours of floor cleaning, with AquaSonar Wi-Fi-to-ultrasound link for app control; unveiled at PSP Expo in October 2025 and on sale from 2026.

The MOVA Diver A10 is a cordless AI robotic pool cleaner for pools up to about 1,900 sq ft with 6,000 GPH suction from triple brushless motors, a 169 Wh battery for up to 210 minutes, and a 3.5 L basket with fine filter screen. Side Hall sensors guide edge cleaning, it scrubs up to 5 cm above the waterline with dual tracks and a front brush, and app scheduling allows up to four cleanings per week; announced in October 2025 and on sale from 2026.

The MOVA Diver R10 is MOVA's entry-level cordless robotic pool cleaner for smaller pools, offering 5,700 LPH suction power, up to 120 minutes of battery life, one-tap start and automatic parking/retrieval; announced in October 2025 and sold from 2026.

The ECOVACS GOAT T Series is an upcoming robotic lawn mower line previewed at IFA 2026 that uses the HoloScope 360 dual-LiDAR navigation system to follow varied yard layouts and a TruEdge Trimmer to cut closely along lawn borders. Pricing and detailed specifications had not been announced.

The HOOKII Neomow X2 is the second-generation wire-free robotic mower from Shenzhen Hookii (Orca Innovation) that navigates by 3D LiDAR SLAM fused with AI vision, with an upgraded 360-degree LiDAR producing ten times more point-cloud data and an optional triple-camera module for 500+ obstacle models. Versions cover 1,500 to 6,000 m2 (LE, SE, X2 and Pro), runtime rose to 150 minutes and cutting height is electrically adjustable from 1.18 to 3.35 inches; launched at CES 2026.

The HOOKII Neomow L series is a wire-free robotic mower for small and medium gardens that combines a 360-degree 3D LiDAR (Hesai JT series) with AI vision, offered as L SE (800 m2), L (1,200 m2) and L Pro (2,000 m2). It adjusts cutting height automatically from 20 to 80 mm, handles 50% (27-degree) slopes on L and L Pro, manages up to 40 zones and has 4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS anti-theft and IPX6 protection; unveiled at CES 2026.

HOOKII Skim is a pool-surface cleaning robot that uses AI vision to recognise and collect floating debris, shown for the first time by Hookii (Orca Innovation) at CES 2026 as its entry into pool care. Mass production was planned for summer 2026.

The KEENMOW K1 is the first robotic lawn mower from service-robot maker KEENON Robotics, navigating without wires or RTK via its AuraVue system (Hesai JT 3D LiDAR plus a 150-degree RGB camera) and SmartPath route planning across up to 15 zones. It passes 0.8 m gaps, climbs 50% (27-degree) slopes on 23 cm wheels, offers 20-70 mm electric cutting height, rain-triggered auto return, a light ring for night mowing, under 60 dB noise, 90 minutes runtime and 100-minute recharge; shown at CES 2026 and launched on Kickstarter in April 2026 from 899 USD.

The MOVA LiDAX Ultra AWD series (1000, 1600, 2000 and 3000 AWD) are RTK-free all-wheel-drive robotic mowers that map automatically with UltraView 3.0 (360-degree 3D LiDAR plus AI dual vision) and climb slopes up to 38.6 degrees with UltraDrive. They use a 36 V battery, 40 cm dual cutting discs with 3-10 cm height adjustment, UltraTrim 2.0 edge cutting, detection of 300+ obstacle types, dual maps with up to 150 zones and anti-theft protection; launched in 2026 and a 2026 Red Dot award winner.

The MOVA ViAX 500 is a vision-only wire-free robotic mower using UltraEyes 2.0 dual Ultra-HDR AI cameras (up to 50 m range, 120 x 70-degree field of view) for AI-assisted auto-mapping, U-shaped mowing and detection of more than 300 obstacle types. It handles 40% slopes, 4 cm obstacles and 60 cm passages, offers on-boundary edge cutting and TrueGuard live-video garden patrol; it launched in 2026.

The MOVA ViAX 250 is a compact vision-only wire-free robotic mower using UltraEyes 1.0 AI binocular cameras for AI-assisted mapping, U-shaped cutting and recognition of 300+ obstacle types, with on-boundary edge cutting and TrueGuard live video patrol. It handles 40% slopes and 4 cm obstacles and has been sold since 2025.

The MOVA 600 (and larger MOVA 1000 with off-road wheels) are wire-free robotic lawn mowers needing no boundary wires, RTK stations or GPS poles thanks to UltraView environmental sensing for mapping and obstacle avoidance. They mow in systematic U-shaped paths with app control and quiet operation; they went on sale in 2025.

The MOVA NAVAX AWD series is an all-terrain, all-wheel-drive robotic lawn mower for large lawns of 1.25 acres and more, unveiled at CES 2026. It uses a Hesai JT-series 3D LiDAR for efficient path planning and precise obstacle avoidance.

The MOVA LiDAX Vector AWD is a robotic lawn mower with a three-wheel all-terrain wheel set and the UltraDrive 2.0 AI all-wheel drive system, climbing slopes up to 38.6 degrees with zero-radius turning and able to drive diagonally, translate sideways and rotate in place. It was launched at IFA 2026.

The Airseekers Tron SE is the entry-level version of the Tron mulching robotic mower from Airseekers (Changyao Innovation), for lawns up to 1,500 m2, navigating without wires or antenna via network RTK plus a 140-degree front AI camera. It has a four-wheel chassis for 65% (33-degree) slopes, a 2,000 W peak motor driving a dual-layer six-blade disc at 3,000 rpm with FlowCut mulching, a swappable 10 Ah battery and IPX6 rating; it launched in Europe in April 2026 at 1,399 EUR RRP.

Cordless robotic pool cleaner from Maytronics that Maytronics says is the first able to clean steps, sun ledges and Baja shelves in water as shallow as 8 inches (20 cm), in addition to floors, walls and the waterline of pools up to 50 ft. The flagship of the EON line adds a backwash filter and DebrisLock; unveiled at CES 2026 and shipped from late January 2026.

Cordless robotic pool cleaner in Maytronics' 2026 EON line that cleans floors, walls, waterline, steps and ledges as shallow as 8 inches (20 cm) in pools up to 50 ft, with selectable 1.5-2.5 hour cycles and app control. It shares the EON 120d's shallow-water capability but omits DebrisLock and uses a fine filter kit.

Solar-powered cordless robotic pool skimmer from Maytronics that charges during the day, paddles across the water surface to collect leaves, insects and pollen, and stores energy for night-time operation in pools up to 65 ft. Introduced in 2026 alongside the Dolphin EON cleaners.

Wire-free robotic lawn mower (model 20512) from The Toro Company that navigates with a vision system plus LiDAR and app-drawn boundaries, rated for complex residential lawns up to 0.75 acre and slopes up to 42%, with an 8 in (20 cm) cutting width and 4.1-8.1 cm cutting height on an 18 V, 90 Wh battery. The Haven robot was first shown in 2024 and appears in Toro's 2027 residential lineup presented at Equip Expo 2026.

Xnowers is a consumer exoskeleton for skiing and snowboarding made by Spanish company Gogoa Mobility Robots. It uses an active suspension system to support part of the wearer's body weight, absorb impacts on the knees and lower back, and reduce muscular fatigue during skiing sessions.

The Ambrogio 4.36 PRO 4WD is a wire-free professional robotic lawn mower from Italian maker Ambrogio (Zucchetti Centro Sistemi) for lawns up to 1,000 sqm. It uses GPS-RTK and ultrasonic sensors for perimeter-free navigation, has four driving wheels, climbs slopes up to 65%, and features a motorised 36 cm stainless-steel blade with a touchscreen display.

Twenty ZR EVO is a compact robotic lawn mower from Italian maker Ambrogio that works without a perimeter wire or GPS mapping, using radar and sensors to recognize lawn edges, avoid obstacles and manage slopes. It requires only a guide cable to return to its charging station, is controlled via a Bluetooth app, and is designed for gardens up to 1,000 sqm with slopes up to 45%.

The Conga Grasshopper 800 ProAI is a wire-free robotic lawn mower from Spanish appliance maker Cecotec for gardens up to 800 sqm. It uses AI-assisted ordered-path navigation with no perimeter cable required, and is controlled through Cecotec's companion app.

The Conga Pooldroid 10000 TotalClean AquaSkater is a robotic pool cleaner from Spanish appliance maker Cecotec that cleans the floor, walls, waterline and surface of pools up to 300 sqm. It has a 180 micron filter, a 230 L/min pump flow rate, and up to 100 minutes of autonomous cleaning per charge, and is suited to all pool types.

Clevon 1 (also marketed as the GO Bot) is a fully electric, lightweight driverless courier robot from Estonian company Clevon, built for last-mile delivery on sidewalks and roads in mapped urban and industrial areas. It operates with SAE Level 4 autonomy, with a single remote teleoperator able to supervise multiple robots at once. Clevon has deployed it commercially in the US and Europe, including the first on-road driverless delivery in North America, in Fort Worth, Texas.

Dolphin Nautilus CC Supreme is Maytronics' premium Wi-Fi robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pools up to 50 ft, scrubbing the floor, walls and waterline with triple active brushes and a top-load interchangeable filter cartridge. It is controlled remotely through the MyDolphin Plus app.

Dolphin Nautilus Titan is a Wi-Fi robotic pool cleaner from Maytronics for in-ground pools up to 50 ft, scrubbing the floor, walls and waterline with an extra-large interchangeable filter basket and a roughly two-hour default cleaning cycle. It is controlled through the MyDolphin Plus mobile app.

Dolphin Liberty 400 is a cordless robotic pool cleaner from Maytronics for in-ground and above-ground pools up to 33 ft, scrubbing the floor, walls, waterline and sun ledges down to an 11 ft depth. It charges on a magnetic dock, runs a default 2.5-hour cycle, and connects to the MyDolphin Plus app once removed from the pool.
Verro was iRobot's first swimming-pool cleaning robot, released in April 2007. It was later succeeded by the Mirra line before iRobot exited the pool-cleaning robot market.

Mirra 530 was iRobot's swimming-pool cleaning robot, the successor to its earlier Verro line, unveiled in January 2013 to clean a pool's floor and walls of debris. iRobot discontinued the Mirra pool-cleaning line in 2014.

Dolphin Oasis Z5i is a Wi-Fi robotic pool cleaner from Maytronics sold through Amazon for in-ground pools up to 50 ft, scrubbing the floor and walls and navigating with the company's CleverClean pathing. It runs a default 2.5-hour cleaning cycle and uses a top-load, multi-layer filter basket.

Dolphin Wave 300 XL is a large commercial robotic pool cleaner from Israeli manufacturer Maytronics built for big hotel and resort pools. It cleans the pool floor on a default 6-hour cycle, collects debris in a top-access filter bag, weighs about 26.5 kg and trails a 165 ft power cable to reach extended pool lengths.

Dolphin Explorer E50 is a corded robotic pool cleaner from Israeli manufacturer Maytronics that scrubs a residential pool's floor, walls and waterline with a top-access, multi-layer filter in a default 2-hour cycle. It weighs about 8.7 kg and is positioned as an entry model in Maytronics' Explorer line below the Explorer E70.

Wasal is a sidewalk-capable, self-driving last-mile delivery vehicle developed by Qatari engineer Saleh Mohammed Al-Abdullah with support from the Qatar Scientific Club in Doha. It carries goods in a sealed, motorcycle-courier-sized storage box, covers a 50 km service radius in residential areas, and is supervised from a central control station that receives live front, rear and 360-degree camera feeds, GPS location, speed and battery data, letting a human operator take over immediately if the fully autonomous vehicle encounters a problem.

AquaSense 3 is Beatbot's flagship in-pool robotic pool cleaner, announced for 2026 with in-pool AI-vision Sense-to-Act technology that recognizes 40+ debris types and 2D mapping with adaptive path planning. It cleans the floor, walls, waterline and shallow platforms down to 18cm depth with 6,800 GPH suction, a 10,000 mAh battery for up to 5 hours of floor cleaning, and a 3L basket with 100um (optionally 3um) filtration.

Sora Neo R is a lightweight robotic pool cleaner from Beatbot built for above-ground pools, announced for 2026 with an industry-leading dual-pump system delivering 5,000 GPH of suction and smart autonomous surface return. Its 4,500 mAh battery provides up to 3 hours of continuous floor cleaning or 2.5 hours in standard mode.
RockMow Z150 is a robotic lawn mower in Roborock's RockMow Z line, sold through Bunnings in Australia alongside the RockMow Z1 LiDAR as Roborock expands into outdoor robotics.

TerraMow Mini 500 is a wire-free robotic lawn mower using AI vision and auto-mapping, the compact entry model in TerraMow's lineup alongside the V600, V1000 and X AWD. It covers up to 500 sq m per mapping, cuts a 180 mm swath at 75-110 sq m per hour (130-250 sq m per full charge), climbs 33% (18 degree) slopes, and is IPX6 weatherproof.

TerraMow V600 is a wire-free robotic lawn mower using AI vision and auto-mapping, part of TerraMow's V series alongside the V1000. It covers up to 600 sq m per mapping, cuts a 203 mm swath at 80-120 sq m per hour (130-250 sq m per full charge) with an electrically adjustable cutting height of 25-75 mm.

The Navimow i206 AWD is a compact entry point in the Segway Navimow robotic lawn mower family, built for yards up to about 0.15 acres. It uses wire-free EFLS RTK network navigation with a 140-degree RGB camera, true three-motor all-wheel drive with electronic stability control, a 7.1-inch single-disc cutting deck, IP66 water resistance, and can handle slopes up to 45 percent.

The WYBOT M3 Pro is a cordless robotic pool cleaner unveiled at Piscine Global Lyon 2026, notable for an autonomous water-exit capability that lets it climb out of the pool and return to its docking station without manual retrieval. It uses underwater 3D mapping and an AI-powered vision system for navigation and obstacle avoidance.

The Scuba S3 is a cordless robotic pool cleaner in Aiper's official Premium tier, sold alongside the Scuba X1, X1 Pro and X1 Pro Max lines on the Aiper store. It is a battery-powered, self-navigating floor-and-wall pool vacuum.
The Dolphin Nautilus CC Plus is a plug-in robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pool floors and walls, with an active scrubbing brush and a top-load filter basket. It cleans a pool in about two hours.

The Dolphin Nautilus CC Pro is a robotic pool cleaner that scrubs pool floors, walls and the waterline using CleverClean and PowerStream navigation, with an extra-large top-load fine filtration basket and mobile app connectivity.

The Dolphin Nautilus AG is a budget robotic pool cleaner built for above-ground and small in-ground pool floors up to 33 feet, with an easy-access top-load fine filtration basket and CleverClean navigation.
The Dolphin S50 is a budget-tier, plug-in robotic pool cleaner that cleans the floor of in-ground and above-ground residential pools, part of Maytronics' 2026 best-value lineup.
The Dolphin Escape is a best-value robotic pool vacuum cleaner that cleans the floor of in-ground and above-ground residential pools.

The Dolphin Nautilus CC is the entry-level model in Maytronics' Nautilus robotic pool cleaner family, cleaning the floor and walls of small in-ground and above-ground pools up to 33 ft with CleverClean navigation and top-load filtration.

The Polaris Freedom LT is a cordless, lithium-ion battery-powered robotic pool cleaner for in-ground pools up to 50 feet long, using two drive motors and tank-style treads to clean the floor, walls and waterline. It pairs over Bluetooth and WiFi with the Fluidra Pool app and is a lower-cost sibling to the Freedom Plus without underwater remote control.

The CNX 30 iQ is a cordless robotic pool cleaner with patented cyclonic suction, helix-shaped brushes and dual-stage progressive filtration for fine and coarse debris. Embedded smart sensors give it full pool coverage on any shape or surface, and it connects to the iAquaLink app for remote control, adjustable cycle times and automatic software updates.

The RA 6900 iQ is a flagship model in Zodiac's Alpha iQ robotic pool cleaner range, using a Sensor Nav System to map the pool and a pressure sensor for wall-climbing and waterline cleaning. It has patented cyclonic suction, dual-stage filtration, a Lift System for easier removal from the water, and iAquaLink app connectivity.

SharkVac is a plug-in robotic pool floor and cove cleaner (SKU RC9740CUB) that runs independently of the pool's filtration system, reducing filter backwash frequency. It requires no hoses, hookups or extra booster pumps.

The TigerShark QC (SKU W3RC9990CUB) is a robotic pool cleaner in Hayward's TigerShark line with a Quick Clean option for shorter cleaning cycles, built to cover virtually every area of a residential pool.

The Automower 410 iQ is an entry-level model in Husqvarna's new Automower iQ Series of robotic lawn mowers for lawns up to about 0.5 acres, with wire-free EPOS satellite-based installation and virtual mapping via the Automower Connect app.

The Automower 420 iQ is a robotic lawn mower in Husqvarna's Automower iQ Series for lawns up to about 1 acre, using wire-free EPOS satellite positioning (with an included reference station, or Husqvarna Cloud where available) and the Automower Connect app for scheduling and virtual boundaries.

The Automower 435 iQ AWD is an all-wheel-drive robotic lawn mower in Husqvarna's iQ Series, with a pivoting rear axle for traction on slopes up to 70 percent and satellite-based EPOS navigation for centimeter-accurate positioning. It covers lawns up to about 1.3 acres and is controlled via the Automower Connect app.

The A 140v is the flagship model of STIGA's autonomous robot mower range (A 6v to A 140v), for lawns up to 14,000 square meters managing up to 30 zones and slopes up to 50%. It has a 14 Ah ePower battery, a 26 cm cutting width, AI camera-based obstacle avoidance (VISTA technology), and is controlled via the STIGA.GO app with zone-based scheduling and encrypted live video streaming.
The SILENO minimo is Gardena's smallest and most compact smart robotic lawn mower, sold in a 500 m2 lawn-size variant for small to mid-size gardens with wire-based boundary installation.
The smart SILENO max 1500 is a flagship robotic lawn mower from Gardena for lawns up to 1,500 square meters, part of the app-connected smart SILENO max series for larger, more demanding gardens.
The smart SILENO pro 600 is a professional-grade robotic lawn mower from Gardena for lawns up to 600 square meters, part of the smart SILENO pro line aimed at demanding terrain and heavier-duty use.
